title: guard-main blocks syncing a main checkout from origin
what: In a main checkout on its default branch, guard-main allows `git merge --ff-only origin/<default>` and `git merge --ff-only FETCH_HEAD` (a fast-forward to the remote, the "Master Sync" of projects that merge by pull request), as it allows `--ff-only wt/<branch>`; any other merge stays refused.
why: 25 Oct, the arsenal pilot design, scratchpad reports/design-arsenal.md (copy in ~/.relay/backup/scratch-3207dc59), section 1.2, measured with fake hook input: arsenal's guard allows exactly `git merge --ff-only origin/master` and blocks `--ff-only wt/x`; relay's guard-main does the reverse, so relay blocks a hand-typed Master Sync in arsenal today. Live in every project that merges by pull request. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen), before the pilot.
failing_case: guard-main.sh fed {"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"git merge --ff-only origin/master"}} with cwd a primary checkout on master: refused.
pass_cases: The same input is allowed; `git merge origin/master` (no --ff-only) and `git merge --ff-only some-branch` from outside wt/ stay as they are today.
where: plugins/core/hooks/guard-main.sh (the merge rule in a main checkout)
